t: What Umar was told about the mattress
a: أَوَفِي هَذَا أَنْتَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، إِنَّ أُولَئِكَ قَوْمٌ عُجِّلُوا طَيِّبَاتِهِمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا
p: Awa fī hādhā anta yā-bna-l-Khaṭṭāb. Inna ulāʾika qawmun ʿujjilat ṭayyibātuhum fi-l-ḥayāti-d-dunyā
m: Are you in this state over that, son of al-Khattab? Those are a people whose good things were brought forward for them in the life of this world.
